ap_ash2_drift.rule: Ash 2.x API terminology MUST NOT be used; use Ash 3.x Domains/Resources/Actions.

ap_banned_tokens.rule: Placeholder markers are forbidden in lockable artifacts.

ap_hybrid_message_class.rule: A message MUST have exactly one message_class; embedding marketing content inside transactional messages is forbidden.

ap_implicit.rule: No implicit defaults for consent, tenancy, dispatch, dedupe, or retention; all MUST rules explicit.

ap_key_naming.rule: Do not use api_actions in contracts; use domain_actions.

ap_regex_theater.rule: Subsystem contracts MUST NOT introduce repo-wide scanning gates; only bundle-scoped assertions are permitted.

ap_secrets_in_comm.rule: COMM artifacts and logs MUST NOT store provider secrets (API keys, SMTP passwords) or raw signing material.

ap_store_rendered_content.rule: Storing full rendered message content is forbidden by default; only render_hash + template pin + redacted variables may be persisted unless legal-required and explicitly enabled.

ap_sync_dispatch.rule: Synchronous message dispatch in checkout/payment/ledger request paths is forbidden; COMM must be async-only.

ap_vendor_template_drift.rule: Provider-native templates MUST NOT be used as the canonical source of truth for auth or transactional messages; vendor UI edits must not silently alter pinned templates.

changes: Renamed test-gates artifact to BP-0 Test_Gates filename format.
Fixed artifact_name metadata to match the current contract artifact filename.
Raised ERR-1 and INT-1 dependency floors to the coordinated clean versions.
Preserved COMM as communications authority while provider routing remains delegated to INT-1.
change_log.summary: Coordinated dependency-floor and artifact-metadata hygiene patch.

changes: Updated COMM-1 dependency floors for CS-0@3.0.0, INT-1 v1.0.3, and ERR-1 v1.8.1.
Replaced stale INT integration_registry wording with ProviderRoutingRule and provider_account_ref semantics.
Normalized string-only COMM error subcode entries to object entries with base and retryable metadata.
Updated automated suite_schema gate from CS-0@2.3.0 to CS-0@3.0.0.
change_log.summary: CS-0@3.0.0 final hardening for COMM dependency floors, INT-1 provider routing alignment, and ERR-1 registry parity.

changes: Removed non-normative PRICE_1 formatting reference from variable_type_system and replaced with deterministic money_display_policy.
Introduced money_display_policy with pinned engine semantics and locale fallback rules (no floating point; ISO-4217 currency codes).
Extended variable_type_system with currency_code_iso_4217 type (append-only).
Fixed artifact_name fields to match bundle filenames and version.
Hardened placeholder ban gate coverage to include all gate entries.
change_log.summary: Remove ambiguous PRICE_1 currency formatting reference; lock deterministic money_display_policy; fix artifact metadata drift; extend gates placeholder coverage.

changes: Declared PII-1, INT-1, SEC-1 as MUST dependencies to make PII boundary and provider posture enforceable.
Locked deterministic_uuid_sorting for all UUID list hashing/signing and apportionment tie-breaks.
Pinned bulk_send audience_snapshot requirements (ref, hash, count) to prevent audience drift after approval.
Enforced strict example variable typing for url_https and iso_datetime_utc.
change_log.summary: Hardening: enforce no-secrets posture; add INT/SEC/PII dependencies; lock uuid binary sorting; pin bulk audience snapshot fields; enforce strict example variable types.

changes: Bumped suite_schema to CS-0@2.3.0 to align with planned suite migration and CANON-1/ERR-1 head.
Locked template canonicality rules (platform source-of-truth for auth/transactional) and introduced versioned layout components with hash pinning.
Defined template import pipeline: import-to-draft only; lint clean required for publish; forbid unsafe links and PII query parameters.
Defined provider_kind matrix (smtp_relay, api_transactional, campaign_platform) and disallowed campaign_platform for auth/transactional.
Locked platform/org audience model and unsubscribe precedence layering via CONSENT-1 + COMM suppression.
Introduced bulk_send governance requiring QUORUM approval above thresholds with cancellation window.
Classified cart abandonment and post-purchase upsell as marketing-only; banned hybrid marketing in receipts.
Aligned retention profiles to DATA-1 (p1_operational, p2_audit_evidence) and reinforced DSAR cryptoshred unlinkability.
change_log.summary: Semantics hardening: template source-of-truth + import pipeline + layout components; provider kind matrix; platform/org scope + bulk send governance; funnel messaging (abandonment/upsell) classified as marketing; DATA-1 retention alignment; CS-0@2.3.0 adoption.

changes: NEW: Initial contract defining message classes, consent gating, template registry, async dispatch semantics, suppression, observability, and retention posture.

rules: Marketing messages MUST require explicit consent per CONSENT-1 for the applicable scope (org_id or platform_org_id).
Transactional messages MUST NOT require marketing consent and MUST NOT be blocked by marketing opt-out.
Unsubscribe and opt-out MUST take effect immediately for future sends within the applicable scope and channel.
Opt-out and suppression decisions MUST be auditable and tenant-scoped; platform scope uses platform_org_id.

Effective send eligibility MUST be computed as: consent_allow (CONSENT-1) AND channel_allowed (COMM opt-out) AND NOT suppressed (deliverability safety). Deny wins within scope; deliverability safety always wins.
Channel opt-out MUST be channel-specific by default. Global opt-out MUST be explicit and recorded as a separate opt_out_scope value.
Complaint-based suppression MUST be treated as deliverability_safety and MUST override all other allowances for that channel.

dependencies.reason: BP-0 defines the CS-0@3.0.0 blueprint discipline and template-of-templates expectations.
Schema compliance for contract/test-gates/manifest artifacts (suite_schema pinned to CS-0@3.0.0).
Test-gates schema and gate authoring conventions.
Constitutional reliability, money, tenancy, and observability invariants applied to comms side effects.
Governance baseline; contract-level anti-pattern bans and enforcement posture.
Repo governance lint alignment for snake_case and banned-token rules.
Multi-tenancy: org_id scoping for all message artifacts and RLS expectations.
Actor identity, capabilities, and audit context.
ERR-1 governs the canonical error envelope and includes COMM_* subcodes for COMM-1 v1.1.5 and later.
Marketing consent gating and consent proof hash model; platform-wide consent via dedicated platform org_id.
Recipient identity boundary, subject mapping, and cryptoshred primitives used by COMM for pseudonymous recipient_ref and webhook PII stripping.
Data classification and retention profile taxonomy (p0..p4) used for COMM retention posture.
Cryptoshred semantics and DSAR orchestration: unlinkability without mutating immutable truth.
Tracking token issuance and PII deny-pattern sanitization; COMM tracking is delegated to TRK only.
Dual-control approvals for platform-scoped and high-impact bulk sends, template kill-switch actions, and overrides.
Telemetry and alerting conventions for delivery outcomes.
Queue capacity, backpressure, and safe mode alignment for async dispatch.
Performance budgets and degraded mode posture for non-checkout side effects.
Lock semantics for publish workflow and dedupe locks (when implemented).
INT-1 owns provider account registry, sender identity, and deterministic ProviderRoutingRule resolution consumed by COMM-1 dispatch attempts.
Provider secrets governance and webhook authentication material; COMM stores only opaque references.
CI strict gate expectations and bundle integrity enforcement.

rules: When hashing/signing over a list of UUIDs or using UUIDs for apportionment tie-breaks, the system MUST normalize each UUID to raw 16-byte form.
The system MUST sort UUIDs by unsigned lexicographic byte order (ascending) over the 16-byte representation.
The system MUST NOT sort UUID strings for any cryptographic or tie-break logic.
COMM bulk/audience snapshot hashing and any multi-UUID hashes in COMM MUST apply these rules.

errors.alignment_rule: All errors MUST be emitted using ERR-1 RFC9457 envelope; COMM_* are ERR-1 subcodes recorded in extensions.subcode.
notes: COMM_* subcodes are domain-specific; top-level code MUST be one of ERR-1 registry.top_level_codes[].code.
Error envelopes MUST include correlation_id/request_id as applicable and MUST avoid raw PII.

classes.description: Messages required to fulfill or secure a user-initiated transaction or account action.
Promotional or engagement messages not required to fulfill a transaction.
Operational notices such as incident notices, status updates, and admin alerts.
Legally required notices such as terms updates or legally required invoices.

rules: provider_failure_rate_thresholds_shall_trip_circuit_breaker
when_tripped_marketing_messages_shall_be_dropped_or_deferred_first
transactional_messages_shall_fallback_to_alternate_provider_if_configured
failed_after_max_attempts_shall_be_written_to_dead_letter_queue
dead_letter_entries_shall_be_queryable_by_tenant_admins_with_capability
dead_letter_replay_shall_require_explicit_operator_action_and_audit_reason
dispatch_must_be_async_via_job_queue
dispatch_must_not_run_in_checkout_request_path
retries_must_be_job_queue_managed_with_exponential_backoff_and_jitter
Auth message requests MUST be non-enumerating: the caller MUST NOT be able to infer account existence from API responses or timing.
Auth message requests MUST be rate-limited per {recipient_ref, org_id, purpose_id} and per caller fingerprint (e.g., ip_hash).
Auth messages MUST use high-priority queues but MUST still respect abuse throttles and safe mode.
Bulk sends MUST be expressed as bulk_send_request objects; direct per-recipient loops are forbidden for bulk operations.
Bulk sends above thresholds MUST require QUORUM-1 approval before dispatch starts.
Bulk sends MUST declare cancel_before_utc and MUST support cancellation until that timestamp.
Bulk sends MUST declare throttle_plan and must not exceed per-provider send limits.
NEW: proposed invariant — bulk sends MUST pin an audience_snapshot_ref at approval time; dynamic audience evaluation after approval is forbidden.
NEW: proposed invariant — bulk send audience snapshot hashing MUST be deterministic and MUST apply deterministic_uuid_sorting when UUID lists are part of the hash base.

dedupe_key_derivation.new_proposed_invariant: dedupe_key_shall_be_sha256_of_canonical_json_of_{org_id,recipient_ref,channel,message_class,template_id,template_version,intent_ref,day_bucket_utc} where intent_ref is a stable domain reference (e.g., ord_id) and day_bucket_utc is derived from requested_at_utc for windowing.

rules: same_dedupe_key_must_not_send_twice_within_dedupe_window
dedupe_state_must_be_shared_across_retries_and_provider_failovers
dedupe_key_must_be_stable_for_the_same_intent
provider_acceptance_and_delivery_state_shall_be_recorded_as_receipts
receipt_events_shall_not_mutate_business_truth
receipt_processing_shall_update_suppression_entries_for_bounce_and_complaint
Same dedupe_key MUST NOT dispatch more than once within its dedupe window.
Dedupe key MUST be computed deterministically from basis_fields_ordered with dedupe_bucket derived from requested_at_utc and message_class window.
Locale selection MUST be deterministic and MUST follow fallback_chain.
If no locale can be resolved, dispatch MUST fail with COMM_LOCALE_UNRESOLVABLE.

purposes.notes: Marketing by default; consent proof required.
Legal; quorum governed for platform scope.

rules: Every message_request MUST declare purpose_id and message_class; purpose_id MUST map deterministically to exactly one message_class.
Cart abandonment, upsell funnels, and newsletter/campaign messages MUST be marketing class and consent-gated.

field_rules: org_id MUST be present; platform-wide messages MUST use platform_org_id (not null).
recipient_ref MUST be pseudonymous subject_key; raw PII is forbidden.
purpose_id MUST be present and MUST map to exactly one message_class via message_purpose_catalog.
template_id and template_version MUST be pinned; dispatch MUST reference a published template version.
locale MUST be resolved deterministically using locale_resolution rules.
variables MUST be allowlisted and typed per template variable_types; unknown keys are forbidden.
Marketing messages MUST include consent_proof_hash_sha256 evaluated by CONSENT-1; missing/invalid proof forbids dispatch.
If tracking tokens are embedded, tracking_proof_hash_sha256 MUST be present and must reference TRK-issued tracking under CONSENT gating.
dedupe_key MUST be present and computed deterministically; same dedupe_key must not dispatch twice within dedupe window.

rules: Platform-scoped messages MUST use platform_org_id and MUST be limited to operational or legal message_class unless explicitly approved as marketing via platform consent.
Platform-scoped sends MUST require QUORUM-1 approval when audience_size_estimate exceeds platform_scoped_quorum_required_audience_size_ge or when purpose_id is legal or operational platform notice.
Platform-scoped override actions (template disable, suppression override) MUST require QUORUM-1.
Resend MUST be an explicit action with resend_intent=true and MUST be rate-limited per {recipient_ref, template_id}.
Resend MUST be audited with actor and reason.
Resend MUST NOT bypass suppression, consent gating, or safe mode.
All message_request records MUST be scoped to an org_id; platform-wide communication MUST use a dedicated platform_org_id.
Platform-wide marketing MUST target subjects who have consented within platform_org_id scope; cross-tenant broadcast to org-scoped subjects is forbidden.
Org-scoped messages MUST NOT target subjects outside the org_id scope.
COMM MUST NOT define tracking semantics. Any tracking tokens, click redirect links, or pixels MUST be issued and governed by TRK-1.
Any tracking embedded in messages MUST be consent-gated via CONSENT-1 with proof hash recorded on the message_request.

determinism.changes_require: New policy_id and contract version bump; previously rendered content MUST remain reproducible via pinned template_version + policy_id + engine version.

rules: Rendering MUST treat money_minor as integer minor units and MUST NOT use floating point arithmetic.
Rendering MUST format amounts deterministically using a single, platform-pinned formatting engine and version (money_display_engine_id + money_display_engine_version).
Rendering MUST require a currency_code for each money amount; currency_code MUST be ISO-4217 alpha-3 uppercase.
Rendering MUST apply locale-specific separators and currency presentation based on locale; when locale is missing or unsupported, fallback_locale MUST be used.
Rendering MUST NOT embed recipient PII in any currency formatting output, metadata, or link parameters.

NEW: proposed invariant — When a template declares variable_types for a money amount {x}_minor, it SHOULD also declare {x}_currency_code with type currency_code_iso_4217; if absent, renderer MUST use a deterministic currency source (org_default_currency_code) and log currency_source='org_default' in metadata.
money_display_policy.scope: Applies to formatting of money_minor variables for all channels (email, sms, whatsapp, push, in_app).

rules: Providers MUST declare sending_domain for email channels.
Org-scoped sending domains MUST require verification and warmup throttling; unverified org domains are forbidden.

provider_kind_definitions.notes: SMTP relay/transactional send; content rendered by platform; receipts may require separate event integration.
Transactional API send; platform renders content; provider supports idempotency keys and webhook receipts.
Audience/campaign platform; provider may own template rendering; NOT allowed for auth/transactional.

rules: COMM MUST NOT use application runtime config as provider routing truth.
COMM MessageDispatchAttempt MUST record provider_account_ref and provider_id used for every outbound attempt.
COMM MUST fail closed with COMM_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE or COMM_PROVIDER_KIND_NOT_ALLOWED when INT-1 routing cannot produce an allowed provider_account_ref.
Auth and transactional messages MUST NOT be sent via campaign_platform providers.
Provider accounts and routing policies MUST be declared in INT-1; COMM provider selection MUST resolve via INT-1 ProviderRoutingRule to one provider_account_ref.
Provider secrets (API keys, SMTP credentials, webhook shared secrets) MUST be governed by SEC-1; COMM MUST store only opaque references.
Provider selection MUST be deterministic: {org_id, channel, message_class, purpose_id?} MUST resolve to exactly one provider_account_ref at dispatch time.
Provider receipt ingestion MUST be authenticated (signature or shared secret) and replay-safe.
Receipts MUST be idempotent by provider_event_id and MUST map deterministically to message_id or provider_message_id.
Hard bounces and complaints MUST update suppression lists immediately.
Webhook events MUST NOT contain raw PII; if provider includes PII, it MUST be stripped and replaced with hashes before storage.

NEW: proposed invariant — when provider webhook payload includes recipient PII (e.g., email address or phone), COMM ingestion MUST call PII-1 mapping to derive recipient_ref and MUST NOT persist the raw PII.
providers_shall_be_allowlisted_and_configured_per_tenant_or_platform
provider_selection_shall_be_deterministic
secrets_shall_not_be_stored_in_templates_or_message_requests
COMM suppression entries are the authoritative source of truth; vendor suppression MUST be ingested into COMM suppression deterministically.
Suppression updates from provider receipts MUST be applied within the same org_id scope unless explicitly declared platform_scoped for deliverability safety.
Complaint suppression MUST require governance review to lift (QUORUM-1 for platform-scoped; IAM capability for org-scoped).
recipient_ref MUST be a pseudonymous subject_key (or equivalent) and MUST NOT contain raw email/phone/device token.
PII resolution (email address, phone number, device token) MUST occur only at final provider handoff, in-memory, and MUST NOT be persisted in message_request, attempt, or receipt records.
If subject mapping is cryptoshredded, COMM MUST NOT recreate or infer PII; dispatch MUST fail closed with COMM_RECIPIENT_UNRESOLVABLE.
Any provider-supplied PII in receipts/webhooks MUST be stripped and replaced with hashes prior to storage (DATA-1 alignment).
PII subject mapping and recipient_ref derivation MUST be governed by PII-1; COMM MUST NOT define or store raw PII identifiers.
COMM MUST treat recipient_ref as the only join key for message lifecycle records; if PII-1 cryptoshreds the mapping, COMM MUST fail closed for delivery resolution.

scope_rules: Suppression entries MUST be scoped to org_id or platform_org_id; cross-scope effects are forbidden unless explicitly classified as deliverability_safety.

Deliverability safety suppression MAY be platform_scoped only when required to protect a shared sending domain reputation; such entries MUST avoid raw PII and MUST be governed by QUORUM-1 when applied platform-wide.

rules: system_shall_support_safe_mode_states_and_backpressure
in_safe_mode_marketing_shall_drop_or_defer_before_transactional
transactional_sends_shall_have_priority_over_marketing
rate_limits_shall_apply_per_org_id_channel_and_recipient_ref
COMM artifacts MUST use DATA-1 retention_profile ids; parallel taxonomies are forbidden.
Message lifecycle metadata (requested/rendered/dispatched/receipts/suppression) SHOULD be labeled p2_audit_evidence unless explicitly downgraded for operational-only records.
Full rendered content MUST NOT be stored by default; store render_hash_sha256, template pin, and redacted variables.
After DSAR cryptoshred, COMM MUST NOT be able to resolve recipient PII; dispatch attempts MUST fail closed.
COMM audit metadata MAY remain but MUST be non-joinable (no recipient PII, no direct identifiers).
COMM MUST NOT recreate PII or re-link subjects after cryptoshred.
Tickets MUST NOT be attached to emails by default; ticket delivery MUST use signed download links with TTL.
Legal invoice attachments MAY be allowed only for legal class messages and MUST be explicitly declared per template with DATA-1 retention_profile alignment.
Layout components MUST be versioned and immutable when published.
Published templates MUST pin layout components by explicit component_id + version; referencing latest is forbidden.
A change to a shared layout MUST publish a new component version; existing published templates MUST NOT change.
Draft templates MAY be modified.
Publish action MUST acquire a template_id scoped lock (LOCKS-1) to prevent concurrent publish.
On publish, template version MUST become immutable and compiled_output_hash_sha256 MUST be populated.
Deprecated templates MUST NOT be used for new message requests.
Disabled templates MUST stop new renders immediately (emergency control).

registry_rules: Templates MUST declare template_source_kind and compiled_output_hash_sha256 when published.
Templates MUST declare owner_scope and (if applicable) override_of for deterministic precedence.
Templates MUST declare variable_types for all required/optional variables.

rules: Published templates MUST reference a rendering_profile_id; ad-hoc rendering rules are forbidden for published state.
In-app templates MUST NOT use raw html; only constrained markup is allowed.

import_rules: Template import MUST create templates in draft state only.
Import MUST run deterministic lint: forbid tracking pixels unless explicitly declared as TRK-issued; forbid unsafe links; forbid PII query params; enforce variable allowlist + typing.
Publish MUST be blocked if lint_report.forbidden_pattern_count > 0.

rules: Platform MUST be the source of truth for auth and transactional templates; provider-native templates MUST NOT be the canonical source of truth for those message classes.
Marketing templates MAY be authored externally, but MUST be imported into COMM as draft and published as an immutable versioned artifact before dispatch.
Published templates MUST be immutable; modifications MUST publish a new template version with migration_notes.
Templates MUST declare variable_types for all required/optional variables using allowed_types.
money_minor MUST be integer minor units; rendering MUST format per money_display_policy.policy_id=comm_1_money_display_policy_v1.
url_https MUST be https and must satisfy link allowlist rules.
NEW: proposed invariant — variable names ending with '_url' MUST use type url_https.
NEW: proposed invariant — variable names ending with '_at_utc' MUST use type iso_datetime_utc.
NEW: proposed invariant — variable names ending with '_minor' MUST use type money_minor.
